```{r}
BiocManager::install("plyranges")
library(plyranges)
```

```{r}
std_chr <- paste0("chr",c(1:22,"X", "Y"))
score_cutoff <- 200
chipatlas_tf_beds <-list.files("data/chip_atalas/mm10/tfs_and_others/camelia_mpl",
                               full.names = TRUE) 
names(chipatlas_tf_beds) <- chipatlas_tf_beds %>% basename() %>% str_split_i("\\.",5)
tf_ranges_lst <- lapply(chipatlas_tf_beds,
                        function(bed_path){
                          
  cat((bed_path))
  plyranges::read_bed(bed_path) %>%                        
  mutate(id = str_extract(name, "ID=[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+") %>% str_remove_all("ID="),
         tf = str_extract(name, "(?<=Name=)[^%]+") %>% str_remove_all("Name=")
           ) %>%
    filter(score > score_cutoff & seqnames %in% std_chr & !is.na(tf)) %>% #filter peaks based on score, chromosome, and 
    group_by(tf) %>% #for each TF, merge overlapping peaks across studies
    reduce_ranges(experiment = paste(id %>% sort %>% unique, collapse= ",")) %>%
    ungroup()%>%
    mutate(n_experiment = sapply(experiment,function(z) {str_count(z, ",")+1}))
  })

tf_peaks_lst <- tf_ranges_lst %>%
    bind_ranges(.id = "source") %>%
    group_by(tf) %>% 
    reduce_ranges(source = paste(source %>% sort %>% unique, collapse= ",")) %>% 
    split(.,.$tf)

```
